title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Ballroom, U. of California on 1970-06-21
lineage: unknown transfer to WAV-1648 marked 2nd-Gen > Wavelab (small edits & speed adjust) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1648 tagged.
source: AUD said to have been recorded by Harry Ely

ai_review.summary: Echoey audience recording of a mixed‑quality show with a novel Not Fade Away→St Stephen segue and strong St Stephen, but overall uneven performance.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an audience‑only sound in a cavernous hall that is often muddy and echo‑filled, lacking any soundboard feed. Musically the concert has moments of interest – notably a rare NFA into St Stephen transition, a shredding Easy Wind, and a powerful St Stephen – yet many listeners find the set uneven and the show forgettable overall.

ai_rating.rationale: One strongly negative review highlights poor recording quality and a bland performance, while another praises a unique song segue; with limited data the combined weighted score yields an average‑below‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cavernous hall sound with pronounced echo, no soundboard source, occasional gunshot/pigpen noise, abrupt ending; overall muddy and less clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual NFA→St Stephen segue flips the typical order, providing a fresh jam structure; pacing is uneven and the concert ends abruptly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal moans on Candyman are noted by reviewers.
